5592afec18.why: The four distinct 128-bit stores, live packed addition, and two live scalar updates are all required at SSSE3.

c5930c56ba.why: Both vectors must be loaded, subtracted, and stored separately, and the live index update also supplies the required flags.

d500317694.why: The index expansion, two independent byte-table lookups per half, and output interleaves all feed required stores or live registers, with no shorter SSSE3 form.

addeb5b547.why: The destructive SSSE3 shuffles and unpacks need the existing copies to preserve their sources, and the stores, scalar updates, and resulting flags are live.

88b1b1362e.why: Each loaded index group produces distinct palette outputs, and the repeated copies are needed by the destructive SSSE3 lookups and interleaves.

66742d6555.why: The dword load cannot become a full-width multiply-add memory operand without reading extra bytes, and the live multiply-adds, word arithmetic, and comparison remain necessary.

2485b90dda.why: The four dword stores use potentially noncontiguous addresses, and both scalar updates and the subtraction flags must be retained.

e67c292ce0.why: Materializing and shifting the constant, transferring it to a vector register, and multiplying are each necessary to produce the live scalar and vector results.

8ef67f51ad.why: The broadcast and zero-upper copy are live, and the unsigned byte absolute difference needs both saturated subtraction directions and their combination.

70876ad3c9.why: The loaded vector is live, and wrapped byte subtraction followed by VPABSB cannot replace the three-operation unsigned absolute difference for arbitrary inputs.

faa0a2b7c1.why: Both loaded vectors and unsigned absolute differences are live, and each difference needs the existing three-operation treatment of the full unsigned byte range.

41fd702c8a.why: The unknown shuffle controls and weights require both arithmetic paths, while the shifts, pack, extraction, four stores, and comparison produce required results.

d639bf0f23.why: Both loads and unpacked vectors are live, and the saturating multiply-adds cannot absorb the subsequent modular word additions for arbitrary operands.

1663415866.why: The broadcast, shuffle, two weighted paths, and separate stores are required, including the final shifted ymm1 value and scalar updates with matching flags.

1129e660ef.why: Both unpacked vectors and weighted outputs are live, and folding the modular word additions into the multiply-adds would change saturation behavior for arbitrary coefficients.

5e9e789b8d.why: Both weighted sums and their shift-and-pack conversion are needed, and the final ymm1 value, pointer, counter, and flags are live.

57abdb06c8.why: All four unpacked vectors and weighted outputs are live, and arbitrary coefficients prevent folding their modular word additions into the saturating multiply-adds.

4c7fd931b8.why: Both output vectors must be computed and stored, while the final shifted ymm1, broadcast ymm2, scalar updates, and flags are all live.

78f630b397.why: The two saturating products per half and their modular additions cannot be fused for arbitrary coefficients, and the live intermediate result, extraction, stores, and comparison are required.

a8dd8bae32.why: Both broadcasts and shuffles feed live arithmetic, and the two shifted weighted outputs, separate stores, pointer update, and flagged counter update are required.
